Entry Social Hierarchy of the Westerlands Entry Social Hierarchy of the Westerlands Lords are good at calculating resources and returns, while vassals value family names and contracts; miners and farmers feel whether wealth benefits them from wages, taxes, and security; the same order may seem natural in the hall.
